notes.title: New Content Update (20.22)!
notes.content:
[b]Hey guys and gals![/b]

we're back again with yet another update, and this time it's [b]a big one[/b]! 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3o7WIHmCnvVONXpLDa/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Some of the highlights include:[/b][/h1][list]
[*]after the Canal level, we have now [b]revamped Pristine Pools and the Workshop[/b]! The levels are much bigger, almost all enemy encounters have been revised or polished, the flow of the levels has been altered, and you can now explore and [b]backtrack through the entire levels[/b] - which is a feature A LOT of you have requested!
[*]two new languages: [b]Turkish and Korean[/b]!
[*]manual region selection for online multiplayer: if you were experiencing connectivity issues when trying to play with friends, please make sure you both select the same region (also if you are outside of Europe make sure to change the setting to your own region!)
[*]localized a lot of graphics to Chinese (shop signs, items, etc.)
[*][b]polished character upgrade stations[/b]: better UI, more useful information is conveyed on screen, overall it should make for a much better experience 
[*]explosions from your own rocket launcher won't kill you anymore
[*]various additional gameplay and weapon balancing 
[*]added new voice samples when picking up weapons for the first time
[*]some additional sound tweaks
[*]various additional bug fixes and crash fixes[/list]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l4pTnpvunhMU40X9C/giphy.gif[/img]

As always I sincerely hope you will enjoy this update! If you have any questions, feedback, or suggestions please don't hesitate to contact me directly (benitosub [at] hotmail dot com) or send an email to techsupport [at] 11bitstudios.com.

Cheers,
Marco

notes.title: Update 19.44
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26503066/f7009fa0267c3d177829069d2a1611a1f165a23b.gif[/img]

Hey everyone, devs here!

As the year draws to a close, we just wanted to take this opportunity to [b]thank everybody for purchasing the game![/b] Your support means everything to us, and thanks to all the great feedback we have received we now have the possibility to [b]tweak, refine, and expand the game even further.[/b]

This begins with [b]Update 19.44[/b] (which should be live by the time you read this) and an [b]updated Canal map![/b] We made some rooms bigger, added new rooms, and re-balanced every enemy encounter. We also added new secret rooms! ;)

Of course this update comes with the usual slew of bug fixes.

And finally the new map features a new enemy: the maggot hive (we tried to recapture some of that Alien Breed vibe with those pesky "face-huggers" chasing you down hallways).

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26503066/0439659ec920486ceab1bf0b1943c06e36130795.png[/img]

Rest assured that this is just a start, [b]as we plan to "revisit" every level in the game (and potentially add a few more!)[/b].

In the meantime we would like to extend our wishes for a [b]Merry Christmas to everybody![/b] We sincerely hope that you will enjoy the update, as well as some quality time with your family or loved ones.

See you all in 2018,
Marco & Thomas

notes.title: Update 19.11
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26503066/dc2a38a29f035982c3176bd77e538c2d8fce3bc5.gif[/img]

Welcome back everyone! 

As part of our continued efforts to improve the game and integrate all the amazing feedback we got, we have just rolled out [b]Update 19.11[/b].

The full change-log is below, but I quickly wanted to go into a bit more detail regarding some [b]core changes contained in this update[/b]:[list]
[*][b]Character switching[/b]: you can now switch characters at any time, for the cost of 50% of your "Special Meter" (except in Amor's Den where it's free). This makes it much easier and more convenient to switch if you are about to lose a character or want to bring different weapons to the fight. 
When using terminals, you can also freely switch between characters, which makes upgrading all characters / weapons much easier as you don't have to run back and forth to a closet. 
Switching while using terminals is free, but when you stop using the terminal you will be switched back to the character you were using before the terminal (except in Amor's Den). Switching is [b]mapped by default to R on the keyboard, and B / Circle on controllers[/b]. If you have changed your mapping you might have to quickly go into the options menu and map it to something else! 
[*][b]Closets[/b]: closets now serve manual save points. We added more closets throughout the levels - some in plain view, some a bit more off the beaten path. You will always find a closet before a boss, but the choice of saving is now yours, rather than imposed by automatic save-points. 
[*][b]Dash[/b]: we adjusted the cool-down on the dash, but more importantly we added visual and audio feedback to let players know when the dash is available again. [/list]

There are a few more changes affecting gameplay (such as a [b]new torso upgrade tier[/b]), but we're hoping these three will drastically improve the game's balance and the overall experience. 

The next update will bring an expanded Canal map with new rooms and secret passages for you to discover, a new enemy, the ability to freely backtrack through most of the level, and a couple more cool surprises!

Until then, we both sincerely hope you will enjoy this update!

[h1][b]FULL CHANGE LOG[/b][/h1] 

[h1][b]BUGS:[/b][/h1] [list]
[*]fixed getting stuck in canal bridges when coming in at a particular angle from the left 
[*]fixed tool ammo not refilling correctly when picking up the same tool 
[*]fixed mapping an action to pressing the left or right sticks 
[*]if you map movement to the right stick, aiming now correctly switches to the left stick 
[*]fixed wrong entry in darts mini-game instructions 
[*]fixed sound bug when hovering with mouse cursor over unavailable ammo selection in weapon upgrade stations 
[*]fixed bug preventing the chainsaw from being unlocked in Chinese language settings 
[*]fixed some German translations[/list]

[h1][b]GAMEPLAY:[/b][/h1] [list]
[*]dedicated Chinese server for online multiplayer 
[*]closets now serve as manual save-points 
[*]switching characters is now available at any time for mana cost 
[*]you can now switch characters while using terminals or upgrade stations
[*]adjusted dash cool-down to 800ms 
[*]added visual feedback for dash cool-down / when dash is available again 
[*]you can now buy amber balls from the black market guy as well as sell them 
[*]hacking tool now gives visual and audio feedback when there is nothing to hack close enough to the player 
[*]judge office cut-scene now highlights unlocked door 
[*]increased crab-barrel damage 
[*]increased rocket launcher damage and area of effect 
[*]adjusted various sound volumes 
[*]made grenade a bit faster 
[*]added a new torso upgrade tier and increased the cost of the "self-healing" upgrade 
[*]destructible wall fans, suitcases, and trolleys in the train station 
[*]added tutorial about switching characters[/list]

As always if you have any issues, questions, suggestions, or feedback please feel free to contact me directly (my username at hotmail dot com) or contact 11 bit studios through Steam or using techsupport@11bitstudios.com.

Cheers, 
Marco & Thomas

notes.title: Update 18.48
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26503066/4a6cced49beef10a116e348ae653adb6f689f3d7.gif[/img]

Hey everyone, benitosub here.

I just pushed our [b]latest update (18.48) live[/b]! This time around the change log is a bit shorter, but the issues are a bit more important.

So without further ado, here's what we fixed/tweaked in 18.48:

[h1][b]ONLINE MULTIPLAYER:[/b][/h1][list]
[*]fixed matchmaking with stranger bug: play with random strangers should now always work (provided somebody else is online and looking to match of course!)
[*]improved cached region selection
[*] fixed "incompatible savegame" bug
[*]for Chinese players, we're now routing through the Russia East region. Our Chinese partners have tested the patch and were able to play online, but since I can't test it myself, if you are in China and are still experiencing connection issues please don't hesitate to get in touch![/list]
[h1][b]SOUND:[/b][/h1][list]
[*]tweaked volume balance on some sounds (first pass)
[*]added maggot death sound
[*]added audio feedback when trying to hack something that cannot be hacked[/list]
[h1][b]LEVELS:[/b][/h1][list]
[*]new train station map
[*]drafting table in train station is now destructible
[*]boiler in train station is now destructible
[*]train driver now leaves a corpse behind[/list]
[h1][b]GAMEPLAY:[/b][/h1][list]
[*]balanced tool ammo
[*]left arm upgrades now increase tool ammo
[*]nerfed self-healing torso's healing rate
[*]nerfed rail-gun
[*]reduced duration of hacking mini-game
[*]reduced duration of Spy's special attack
[*]made maggots less "bullet-spongy"
[*]maggots now hurt you when you step on them[/list]
[h1][b]GRAPHICS:[/b][/h1][list]
[*]polished Supercrab's graphics
[*]polished Pristine Pool "fire-waterfalls" graphics
[*]reduced transparency on mini-map's guiding beam to improve its visibility[/list]
We also posted an update on Kickstarter which outlines our plan for the coming weeks to improve the game's experience.

It was originally mostly intended for our backers, but it's available for anyone to view so if you are interested in where the game is headed, please feel free to visit [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/514621648/tower-57/posts/2052722][b]it here[/b][/url]. 

And finally thank you to everyone who backed and/or purchased the game, and to everyone who left reviews, whether negative (your feedback is what helps us improve the game) or positive (your kind words are what keeps us pushing forward).

We plan to release another update next week which will address some seemingly smaller but potentially annoying issues, as well as more balancing and slowly but surely more content, so keep an eye out for that.

Cheers everyone!

notes.title: Tower 57 - update 18.27
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26503066/8f1514f2cc003eeec7c23acb5973ff2722457aa1.gif[/img]

[b]Hi everyone![/b]

A brand new patch 18.27 is here!

[h1][b]List of changes:[/b][/h1][list]
[*]added TCP / UDP network protocol option in Gameplay options to help with "connection error" (a.k.a. the router blocking the ports). Please experiment with those settings to find the solution that works for your the best
[*]Increased game readability - added some additional darkening and transparency to debris on the floor.
[*]added mouse controls to hacking mini-game[/list]
[h1][b]List of fixes:[/b][/h1][list]
[*]fixed getting stuck between bookcases in Pristine Pools
[*]fixed bug where controls would switch to gamepad after dying if a gamepad was plugged in
[*]fixed getting stuck behind the Fortune Teller in Pristine Pools
[*]fixed looping cutscene bug in the Train
[*]fixed achievement progress bars
[*]added a series of missing Chinese translations[/list]
More to come soon! Thank you for supporting us and thank you for all your comments! And as always - if you experience any additional issues/bugs, let us know by writing to [b]techsupport@11bitstudios.com[/b]. 

Cheers!

notes.content:
Hey guys and gals!

Dev of Tower 57 here! I just wanted to let everybody know that I am [b]currently fixing the broken achievement progress bars[/b]. 

This means that during the next few hours, [b]you might notice your achievement progress bars resetting to 0[/b] for the following achievements:
[list][*]Multiple Personalities
[*]Reanimator
[*]Completionist
[*]all loot-crate based achievements[/list]
PLEASE DO NOT BE ALARMED!

[h1][b]This change is NOT permanent, and you will NOT lose any progress accumulated, even during the maintenance.[/b][/h1]

Instead the progress bars will sync up once you update to the next patch (which we are hoping to roll out today), and achievements will unlock accordingly.

I apologize to all of you for any inconvenience caused by this change. 

Thank you again for purchasing Tower 57, we have heard your feedback loud and clear (both positive and negative) and are working very hard to fix, tweak and polish the game accordingly!

Cheers,
Marco

notes.content:

[b]Hi everyone![/b]

[h1][b]Build 18.2 is finally here to fix most of the problems you reported.[/b][/h1]

[*]spikes in Trainstation level now stay hidden when flipping switch

[*]grenade shrapnel doesn't hurt player anymore
[*]hacking tutorial only displayed in offline mode
[*]items are not piled up anymore when character dies
[*]improved visual feedback for picking up items
[*]increased coin attract distance
[*]revived characters now respawn with missing limbs
[*]"special ready" voice now only plays for local player in online mode
[*]rebalanced winnings from the casino
[*]moved the tool tutorial to the start of the Canal (when you enter the room with the first loot crate)[/list]
[h1][b]List of fixes:[/b][/h1][list]
[*]fixed bug with map during cutscenes
[*]fixed death during hacking
[*]fixed getting stuck in the sarcophagus in the Canal
[*]fixed getting stuck in hotel room chairs in Amor's Den
[*]fixed bug where 2 music tracks would play if you opened the in-game options menu inside the hotel, fortune teller, shops, etc.
[*]fixed getting stuck in sinks in Pristine Pools and Elite Quarters
[*]fixed getting stuck in lounging chairs in Pristine Pools
[*]fixed chainsaw sound when tossing due to pick up of other weapon
[*]fixed a bug in the credits scene achievement text[/list]
[b]We're also improving our matchmaking system[/b] as an reaction to the "connection error" problem but since it's a bigger task we'll still need few extra days to finish this. 

[b]As always - if you experience any additional issues/bugs, let us know by writing to techsupport@11bitstudios.com.[/b] We're very grateful for your feedback!

Cheers!

notes.title: [Backer Update 6.68] Special attacks and more!
notes.content:
[img]http://pixwerk.net/home/images/GDC/up3.gif[/img]

Greetings, Agents!

We decided to make another small [b]update for the game[/b]. It's complementary to the last one - based on some feedback that we received during GDC and from you.

[b]What has changed?[/b][list]
[*]we've fixed some small issues with the tutorials
[*]polished shooting mechanics with new visual and sound effects
[*]controls should feel a more precise
[*]all new weapons and special attacks (which are unique to each character) are now balanced better and are closer to the finished quality
[*]polished cutscenes with visual elements instead of just text
[*]additional minor gameplay tweaks[/list]
[b]Important note 1[/b]: if you had the game installed before - old files may cause some issues with the new build. Be sure to go to games directory in Documents folder (\Users\[your username]\Documents\Tower57) and delete all the old files.

[b]Important note 2[/b]: the new tutorial is adapted for controllers. [b]Game works perfectly fine on keyboard+mouse[/b] - but we don't have tutorial ready for it, yet. So if you do not want to shoot someone by mistake - please use "F" key on you keyboard when interacting with objects (when "A" appears on the screen).

If you have any ideas, suggestions or issues - please feel free to comment in this discussion!

Cheers!

- polished cutscenes with visual elements instead of just text

notes.title: Backer Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26503066/b93f0533fa0e1b746ea43f204a0eb4746027d72c.png[/img]

Hello there, Agents!

[h1]As you may have noticed, [b]there was a small Backer Update for Tower 57 on Steam[/b].[/h1]

Here's what we've updated:[list]
[*]game now starts at the train station, not on the train - we believe it's a better, faster way to start the game and introduce the basic mechanics
[*]added few tutorial tips at the beginning
[*]a lot of balancing stuff - game should be easier and more intuitive now - let us know what you think!
[*]now you can switch between characters during game - you can do that in special areas
[*][b]upgradable weapons added![/b]
[*]two first levels and the hub area are available
[*]local coop is available for testing purposes
[*]some minor tweaks
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26503066/eaed117e76ca20bb01f0f1cf59eced9cf296df5b.png[/img]

Remember that game is still in alpha state - errors, bugs and crashes may occur. Please let us know about them in this discussion, if possible. Hope you'll enjoy the changes, though!

[b]Note[/b]: if you had the game installed before - old files may cause some issues with the new build. Be sure to go to games directory in Documents folder (\Users\[your username]\Documents\Tower57) and delete all the old files.

Enjoy!

[h1]LUCK IS MEASURED BY AMMO CAPACITY[/h1]

We are very proud to announce a new game developed by Pixelwerk and published by 11 bit studios!

[h1]What is Tower 57?[/h1]
[b][i]Tower 57[/i] is a fast-paced neo-retro shooter where cooperation is as important as your ammo capacity[/b]. As a member of an extraordinary task force fight your way through a dieselpunk megatower and uncover its hidden secrets.

[h1]Main features:[/h1][list]
[*]Rich and vibrant pixel art dieselpunk world 
[*]Roster of seven diverse characters with different skillsets and equipment 
[*]Campaign designed for single player & (local/online) co-op playthrough 
[*]Highly destructible environment 
[*]Fast-paced arcade gameplay[/list]
